subject.title: feat(android): add Wear conversations, voice, agents, and sessions

question: Should OpenClaw land the staged status-only Wear companion first, or sponsor this complete conversations/voice implementation and retire the overlapping staged PR?
rationale: The merged protocol approves the security architecture but not the user-facing scope, release track, or sequencing; both open PRs implement the same Wear product at materially different breadth.

options.title: Land status first
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803 as the bounded first slice, then rebase and narrow this PR into a follow-up after operational feedback.

options.title: Sponsor the full companion
options.body: Choose this PR as canonical, close the staged overlap, fix the runtime blockers, and explicitly approve the Wear artifact and Play-track rollout.

options.title: Pause Wear runtime rollout
options.body: Keep only the merged shared protocol on main and pause or close both runtime implementations until Android roadmap capacity is available.

recommendation.title: Land status first
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803 as the bounded first slice, then rebase and narrow this PR into a follow-up after operational feedback.

likelyOwner.reason: Android ownership is explicitly assigned to @obviyus and the unresolved choice spans Android product scope, privacy defaults, packaging, and release operations.
